result.title: Automating Multi-View Quality Assessment of 3D Annotation Layouts
result.summary: Text labels provide descriptive information about elements in visual scenes. In 3D visualization, the arrangement of these labels and their connections to target locations forms an annotation layout. Assessing layout quality supports comparisons between alternative layouts. However, existing quality measures often focus on specific layout properties and may not fully reflect human judgments of overall quality. Moreover, a layout may appear clear from one viewpoint but suffer from occlusion or clutter from another. To address these issues, we propose a multi-view quality assessment method based on a multimodal large language model (MLLM). We fine-tune a compact MLLM using structured supervision from human ratings to predict a rating for each quality dimension in each view. These ratings are aggregated into view-level and sample-level quality scores. To support training and evaluation, we construct the Annotation Layouts with Quality Assessment (ALQA) dataset, containing 3,216 layout samples from 1,072 3D objects across 13 categories. Each layout is rendered from 5 predefined viewpoints, and each view is independently rated by 3 human raters across 5 quality dimensions. On ALQA, our method agrees more closely with human reference scores than the evaluated MLLM baselines, and a user study demonstrates strong agreement with human preferences in layout ranking.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向 3D 标注布局质量评估，构建含 5 视角与 5 个质量维度人工评分的 ALQA 数据集，并用结构化监督微调小型 MLLM，将逐视角、逐维度打分聚合为视角级与样本级质量分数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「逐视角、逐维度评分再聚合成整体判断」的结构化监督与多视角证据整合方式，可能为 LVR 中多视角视觉证据筛选与贡献分配提供可供核查的线索，但任务本身并非推理机制研究。
